title: Code and data for: Learned measurement-conditioned priors for matrix-product-state tomography

creators.name: Xu, Jian
creators.affiliation: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project

description: Code, result files and IBM hardware measurement records for the paper 'Learned measurement-conditioned priors for matrix-product-state tomography' (J. Xu, D. Zeng, J. Paisley, Q. Zhao). Includes MAP refinement with a learned measurement-conditioned prior, the chi-squared gate, tuned MLE and classical-shadow baselines, and the scripts that regenerate every table and figure.
